FILING_DESTINATION.detail: The registry's destination for this track is {kind: court, name: 'The court of conviction'}. participant-instructions.md names it under 'Where this goes': 'File in the court of conviction', quoting the committed record, and repeats it at step 10 with the order filed alongside the application. The guide also tells the participant that the court's own NAME must be written on the ____ COURT OF ARIZONA line of both forms because no held record establishes which Arizona court convicted them, which is consistent with the same line being classed REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING on both documents.

FEE_AND_WAIVER.detail: The controlling record states no fee and no waiver: the manifest's pay_fee item is 'The source review does not state a filing fee for the standalone certificate application' and its apply_fee_waiver item is 'The source review does not address a fee waiver'. The guide states both verbatim under 'What it costs' and does not convert silence into a promise - 'No fee is stated for this application, and that is a gap in the record rather than a promise that it is free' - then instructs the participant to ask the clerk of the court of conviction what it costs and what to do if they cannot pay, and states that nothing in the packet is a fee-waiver form because the record names none. Both strings also appear verbatim in the requiredBeforeFiling block.

SERVICE.detail: The manifest's serve_party item is 'The source review does not state a service requirement for the standalone application'. The guide states that under 'Who else has to be told' and then names, from the order's own printed first finding, that the prosecutor must have received a copy of the application, and tells the participant to ask the clerk how that court gets the application to the prosecutor and whether they must deliver it. It also carries the registry destination detail that where a victim requested post-conviction notice the attorney for the state notifies them, and separately states that no notarisation is stated and that the application is a declaration under penalty of perjury rather than a sworn affidavit. I confirmed from the bytes that neither form carries a certificate-of-service block.

SELF_HELP_STOP.detail: The registry's selfHelpStopConditions are three: a state or victim objection, a hearing being set, and a denial the person wants to challenge. All three are named in the guide's 'When to stop and get help' list and again in the body ('If the state or a victim objects, or a hearing is set, or a denial arrives that you want to challenge ... Get an Arizona lawyer'). The guide adds four further stops - doubt about offence class, an earlier certificate under A.R.S. 13-905(L), doubt about whether the conviction was actually set aside, and any immigration matter - and a closing statement that the packet is not legal advice, is not filed for the participant and does not decide eligibility.

OBSERVATION FOR CAPTAIN, not a defect in this packet: MASTER_QUEUE.json labels this family's implementationStrategy participant_agency_application while the controlling legal record does not. I read data/record-clearing/legal-design-intake/FL.memo.json track fl-self-defense at sha256 9b497440290abd5e254b3bd9e1ff6e5dda56abf4c2bfca63dc351090d76e4065 and its outputStrategy is the string 'official_pdf_fill', and its legalDesignDecision.rationale quotes the Florida amendment 'FL-6, lawful self-defense expunction | official_pdf_fill on the dedicated FDLE application'. REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING.detail: Checked line by line against the committed records rather than the builder's ledger. The registry packet set carries seven requiredBeforeFiling strings and participant-instructions.md carries all seven verbatim under 'Do these before you submit' - I compared each on whitespace-normalised text and all seven match. Critically, this family's registry ALSO carries a supportingDocuments entry with requiredBeforeFiling true - the prosecutor certification from the State Attorney for the circuit - and unlike the CO family this lane failed on 20260909b, the guide does not omit it: it has its own section 'The one thing this packet cannot do for you', it is repeated under 'Documents to obtain' with the record's own howToObtain text, and filing-instructions.md makes it step 2. The registry's two manualCompletionItems (prosecutor certification fields, applicant signature) are both named. Separately, the seven form blanks the field map classes requiredBeforeFiling (race, sex, Florida driver licence number, and race, sex, place of birth and the ORI/stamp on the fingerprint card) each appear in the guide's 'Blanks you must fill in before you submit' with FDLE's own checklist quoted as the authority for requiring them.

ROUTE_OPTIONS.detail: Measured against the field map and the paper. Not one of the 88 refusals carries routeDetermined true, and reading FDLE40-026 itself confirms why: FDLE publishes a separate application per statute and this one is the self-defense application, so the route is stated by which form it is rather than by a tick. The only tick-shaped marks on the document are the notary's 'Personally Known ___ or Produced Identification ___' pair, which belongs to the notary, and the instructional checklist glyphs on page 5, which are printed guidance and not fields. Nothing route-determined is left unselected.

REPEATING_ROWS.detail: Two repeating structures, both measured from the bytes. (1) The eight-row Date(s) of Arrest / Charge(s) Description table on page 1: the canonical fixture fills row 1 with both cells (03/11/2022 and 'Aggravated Assault with a Deadly Weapon, Fla. Stat. 784.021(1)(a)') and leaves rows 2-8 wholly empty; the boundary fixture fills rows 1, 2 and 3 with both cells each and leaves rows 4-8 wholly empty. No row carries a date with no charge or a charge with no date. (2) The eight-line certification table on page 2 (Charge(s) Description, Statute Violation, Case Number, Action): all 32 cells are empty on both fixtures, which is correct because the section is the prosecutor's. The guide states the rule it followed - 'A row with a date and no charge beside it reads as finished and is not, so a row is either wholly filled or wholly empty' - and tells the participant to write further charges in themselves.

Canonical adds 36 words and removes none; boundary adds 74 and removes none. Every added word sits in the participant identity, address, arresting-agency or arrest-row bands of page 1 (all at y <= 397 in poppler top-left coordinates), the name/DOB/phone band at the head of page 2, or the name and DOB band of the fingerprint card on page 3. Nothing is added at the Applicant's Signature or its Date, anywhere in the notary acknowledgment (STATE OF, COUNTY OF, the day/month blanks, Signature of Notary Public, the commissioned-name stamp line, Type of Identification Produced), anywhere below the printed line '*The section below must be completed by the state attorney/statewide prosecutor.*' on page 2 (State Attorney/Statewide Prosecutor, Reviewing Officer, County, Circuit, the certifying signature, its date and Title), or at the Signature of Official Taking Fingerprints or Signature of Person Fingerprinted on page 3. Pages 4 and 5 receive no ink at all. The field map's own role census agrees: 39 refusals are the prosecutor's, 6 the notary's, 4 protected signature/date fields, 1 the fingerprinting agency's.

Read back from the delivered text the order is exactly that, and each delivered page matches the same-numbered source page word for word apart from the added values: page 1 the application (footer 'Page 1 of 2 / Revised October 2019 / FDLE40-026'), page 2 the written certified statement, page 3 the fingerprint card, page 4 GENERAL INFORMATION, page 5 the checklist. CLIPPING_AND_OVERLAP.detail: Measured positionally on both fixtures. No added word box falls outside the 612x792 media box, and none comes within 18pt of the right edge. No added word box intersects any printed word box of the source, and no added word box intersects another added word box; the five apparent collisions my first pass reported on the boundary fixture were an artefact of matching words by text - 'and', 'or', 'of' and 'Public' occur both inside the long boundary charge descriptions and in the printed notary and certify lines - and reading the coordinates shows those flagged boxes are the source's own printed positions with no added ink there. FILING_DESTINATION.detail: The controlling record's destination is {kind: agency, name: 'Florida Department of Law Enforcement', detail: 'Dedicated FDLE application. The prosecutor certification is obtained separately by the participant.'}, identical in FL.memo.json and in the track registry. Both guides name it: participant-instructions.md prints the destination and the record's file line 'Submit the dedicated FDLE application with the prosecutor certification'; filing-instructions.md gives the order of operations and the postal address, which I confirmed is FDLE's own printed address on page 4 of the delivered document ('ATTN: Seal & Expunge Section, P.O. Box 1489, Tallahassee, FL 32302-1489') rather than an address the packet invented. The intermediate destination is also named: pages 1 and 2 go first to the State Attorney's office for the circuit, which is what the form itself prints.

FEE_AND_WAIVER.detail: The record states no fee and no waiver: 'The source review does not state a fee for this application' and 'The source review does not address a fee waiver'. Both appear verbatim in participant-instructions.md and again in filing-instructions.md. The packet does not stop at the silence, and it does not invent a figure either: it reports FDLE's own printed checklist on delivered page 5, 'A nonrefundable money order, cashier's check or personal check for $75.00 made payable to FDLE', explicitly attributed - 'This packet prints no fee figure of its own: the $75.00 above is FDLE's own printed checklist speaking' - and tells the participant to pay what FDLE's checklist states and to ask the Seal & Expunge Section if the two disagree. I confirmed the $75.00 line is printed on the source's page 5 and is not added ink. The waiver treatment is likewise honest: 'This packet includes no fee-waiver form, because none is established for this application.'

SERVICE.detail: The record states 'The source review does not state a service requirement', carried verbatim in both guides. Against that silence the packet names, from the form's own printed words, who must actually receive the paper: the State Attorney/statewide prosecutor's office must receive pages 1 and 2 ('*Page 1 and 2 of this application must be submitted to the state attorney/statewide prosecutors office.*'), the fingerprinting agency must take and sign the page-3 card and apply its ORI or stamp, the clerk of court in the county of origin supplies the certified dispositions, and the completed packet goes to FDLE. Notarisation is handled the same way: the record says none is stated, and the guide adds FDLE's own printed requirement that the applicant sign before a notary public or deputy clerk, with the instruction not to sign page 1 until then.

SELF_HELP_STOP.detail: The record's three selfHelpStopConditions - the prosecutor declining to certify, any immigration matter, and anything the participant wants to argue rather than assert - are all printed under 'Stop and get help' in participant-instructions.md. The first is given its own section earlier as well, quoting the record's post_generation_handoff limitation 'If the prosecutor declines, route to counsel'. The guide also states plainly what the packet cannot do ('LegalEase does not obtain or review it') and prints the route's open release blocker so the participant knows the source-currency question is unresolved.
